scope: independent supplemental rendering and structural visual recheck of the eight current v2 atlases

methods.name: multi-background rendered-size inspection
methods.result: No new opaque background, alpha-hole, edge-loss, or proportion hard failure was promoted; the four previously confirmed rows remain visibly abnormal.

methods.name: locally motion-compensated upper/lower residual review
methods.result: Lower-body registration plus a bounded local translation search produced no additional hard-failure candidate. Residuals were treated as evidence only, so ordinary gestures and identity-preserving head motion were not rejected automatically.

methods.name: non-adjacent normalized-crop similarity graph
methods.result: Nine high-similarity non-adjacent pairs were surfaced for review; they correspond to ordinary repeated idle/review poses or expected pose reuse and do not add a confirmed hard failure.

methods.name: rendered loop-seam and playback-cadence comparison
methods.result: Loop-seam changes remain state-specific gesture or direction returns; no new visible snap, reversal, or inert row was confirmed beyond the four known hard failures.

methods.name: high-contrast alpha/edge proof sheets
methods.result: The edge and silhouette overlays independently reproduce the two jumping duplicate heads, the foodie waiting stacked heads, and the delivery failed pose-family switch; butler and chef idle edge changes remain ordinary blink motion.

confirmed_hard_failures.evidence: stacked head and ear contours across the row
duplicated head in frames 0-3 and pose-family switch at frame 4

generation.reason: The available image channel returned a local or private-network result URL for the repair attempts; no consumable replacement image was accepted.

result: Supplemental visual methods add no new hard failure. Release remains blocked until the four complete rows are regenerated and all visual and deterministic gates are rerun.
